page: OVHcloud c2-120 is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture, offering 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs with hyperthreading disabled. Powered by a 3.0 GHz Intel Haswell processor, the virtual machine operates under KVM virtualization and includes dedicated hardware cache allocations of 32 KB L1 data cache, 4 MB L2 cache, and 16 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity is set at 120.0 GB, yielding 3.75 GB per core. The server includes 400 GB of local SSD storage, 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and does not bundle dedicated GPU hardware. Instruction support includes AVX, AES, BMI2, and FMA, whereas modern instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AMX are absent.

Benchmark measurements indicate solid, balanced throughput across multi-threaded operations, counterbalanced by modest single-threaded compute figures. The instance records an average Geekbench single-core score of 1144.0, which falls into the lower 25th percentile, reflecting the aging Haswell architecture. In contrast, multi-threaded metrics remain competitive across mainstream suites, yielding 49032.04 on stress-ng multi-core and 10971.0 on Geekbench multi-core. Parallel compression tasks demonstrate strong throughput, evidenced by bzip3 multi-threaded decompression hitting 253.18 GB/sec in the upper quartile. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 113.21 GB/sec alongside 38.36 GB/sec uncached write bandwidth, pairing with Redis SET performance of 47.17 million operations per second and 21.65 GB/sec static web serving throughput. Natural language text generation remains in the lower tier due to instruction constraints and lack of hardware accelerators.

Because each of the 32 vCPUs corresponds to an unshared physical core, the server delivers consistent CPU execution without hyperthread contention. The resource allocation prioritizes high core count and reliable baseline networking over modern vector acceleration. OVHcloud c2-120 is appropriately suited for multi-threaded compilation pipelines, batch data processing, relational database management, and parallel static web services that benefit from dedicated core isolation.
description: OVHcloud c2-120 is a compute-optimized instance engineered for parallel workloads requiring dedicated compute resources. Operating on KVM virtualization, it features 32 dedicated physical cores on a 3.0 GHz Intel Haswell x86_64 CPU without hyperthreading, alongside 120.0 GB of RAM (3.75 GB per core), 400 GB of local SSD storage, and a 10 Gbps network baseline. While single-thread benchmarks like Geekbench (1144.0) reflect older architectural limits, multi-threaded throughput is solid, achieving 49032.04 in stress-ng and an upper-quartile bzip3 decompression rate of 253.18 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth reaches 113.21 GB/sec for uncached reads, supporting steady database and caching performance with 47.17 million Redis SET operations per second. Lacking AVX-512 or GPU accelerators, the instance trades advanced AI capabilities for dependable CPU core isolation, making it effective for software compilation, data transformations, static web traffic, and backend database services.
